item.title: Study finds wide credit score gaps across bureaus amid tri-merge debate
item.description: A study by Andrew Davidson & Co. found meaningful credit score discrepancies among the three major bureaus.

item.title: Kiavi closes $350M RTL securitization, nears $7B in total issuance
item.description: Kiavi closed a $350M securitization, adding $1.2B in funding and expanding its AI-powered platform for real estate investors.

item.title: REMAX posts higher 2025 net income despite U.S. agent drop
item.description: REMAX’s 2025 net income rose to $8.2 million as U.S. agent count fell 6.1% but global agents increased 7.9%.

item.title: 2025 new-home sales inched up; concessions weakened prices
item.description: New home sales rose 3.8% in 2025 as builders cut prices and offered incentives, but inventory remains above historic norms.

item.title: New home sales still at multiyear highs
item.description: New home sales remain steady at 745,000 in December 2025, while housing permits show no growth and inventory declines.

item.title: Opendoor posts $1.3B loss in 2025 but sees path to profitability
item.description: Opendoor lost $1.3B in 2025 as home sales and purchases fell, but executives project breakeven by end of 2026.

item.title: Trade groups push for lower MSR capital charges, tailored mortgage risk weights
item.description: Eight trade groups representing lenders are urging federal regulators to revise bank capital rules by adopting a more tailored risk weight for mortgages held on balance sheets and by significantly cutting the capital charge applied to mortgage servicing rights.

item.title: Zillow seeks dismissal of consolidated RESPA lawsuit in Seattle
item.description: Zillow filed to dismiss a consolidated RESPA lawsuit, arguing no harm or illegal referrals in its agent and loan programs.

item.title: Weekly pending home sales back to year-over-year growth as we head into spring
item.description: Last week, pending home sales rose 4.6% year over year, inventory reached 700,259 and mortgage rates held near 6%.
